findings.where: canvas 1, right edge (x 1100-1364 of a 1242 canvas) and lower-left
findings.evidence: "跑出页面的字" starts at x 1100 and is 264px wide, so it is cut at the 1242 edge (tile 1242-00 shows "跑出页" and half a glyph); "压在下面的字" and "压在上面的字" are absolutely positioned 40px/10px apart and print on top of each other; "被色块盖住的字" at y 1220 sits under the #cc0000 block (60,1200,500x120) and is invisible.
findings.before: Absolutely positioned lines with fixed x/y and no collision check
findings.after: Lay text in normal flow inside an 80% safe zone (x 124-1118) and keep blocks out of text boxes; re-export until nothing clips or overlaps
findings.why: Clipped, stacked and hidden text is the plainest sign nobody looked at the render before shipping.
findings.title: Social visual QA: fonts loaded, no overflow/clipping, inside central 80%, ≥4.5:1, aligned
Language and title set
findings.fix: Add lang and a specific title.

findings.where: canvas 1, "被色块盖住的字" under the red block
findings.evidence: The p at (80,1220) is fully covered by div (60,1200,500x120) background #cc0000 painted on top; the text exists in the DOM and is read by assistive tech and text extraction but is invisible to sighted readers.
findings.before:
被色块盖住的字

under a later absolutely positioned red div
findings.after: Move the block out of the text box, or give the text z-index above it with 4.5:1 contrast on #cc0000 (white text on #cc0000 is 5.9:1)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence and 1.4.3 Contrast: visible and programmatic content diverge; covered text has no usable contrast.
findings.title: Keep reading order and screen-reader order equal to visual order.

findings.evidence: "跑出页面的字" is clipped by overflow:hidden at x 1242 (only "跑出页" visible); "这一行跨过了接缝" will be split across two exported images.
findings.before: .xhs-page { overflow: hidden } with text placed past its width
findings.after: Constrain text boxes with max-width inside the canvas (left + width <= 1118) instead of relying on overflow clipping
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.10 Reflow analogue for fixed canvases: content must not be lost to clipping. Nearest curated card A11-009.
findings.title: Zoom never blocked

findings.evidence: Every text line is placeholder that names its own defect: "小字标签" (small label), "这是一段折成好几行的正文，字号太小……" (a paragraph whose font is too small), "跑出页面的字", "压在下面的字", "被色块盖住的字", "网格塌下来压到这行说明", "这一行跨过了接缝". The sweep's placeholder detector did not catch Chinese self-describing filler.
findings.after: [DATA NEEDED: the post's title, body copy and images]
findings.why: Placeholder residue on a shippable canvas; nothing on it belongs to any account or post.
findings.title: No placeholder residue at ship
findings.fix: Fill with real content or a visible [DATA NEEDED] slot.

findings.evidence: Failed T-FIVE-SECOND: the first canvas has no title, no hero image and no hook, only a small label and a paragraph; a reader cannot tell what the post is about, who it is for, or why to swipe. Canvas 2's six dark squares (a collapsed grid) overlap the caption "网格塌下来压到这行说明".
findings.before: Label + paragraph + scattered lines on white
findings.after: Cover = one hook headline matching the post title plus one real visual (SOC carousel cover rules); later cards carry one point each
findings.why: Without a narrative role per card the set is a default dump of text boxes.
findings.title: Answer the five form questions before each page/screen/shot: narrative role, viewer distan

findings.evidence: "这一行跨过了接缝" spans x 1100-1452 across the 1242 seam of a two-panel strip; when the feed splits the strip, the line is cut in half on both images.
findings.before: Text at x 1100 on a 2484 strip
findings.after: Keep text wholly inside one panel (x <= 1118 or >= 1366); only the image subject may straddle the seam
findings.why: Panorama strips must survive being split; text across a seam breaks on both cards.
findings.title: Panorama strip: protagonist straddles seam (~2/3 left, ~1/3 right)

findings.evidence: "小字标签" is 24px and the body paragraph 34px on a 1242px canvas; the canvas shrinks about 3x in the phone feed, so these read at roughly 8px and 11px.
findings.why: Type that cannot be read in the feed is filler, whatever it says.
findings.title: Type floors on phone-viewed canvases (image shrinks ~2.8× on phone)

findings.where: html > body > section.xhs-page:nth-of-type(1) > p:nth-of-type(2)  "这是一段折成好几行的正文，字号太小，在手机上读起来会很吃力。"
